name: crook
description: Tells the Crook tab Claude Code runs in what it is doing, lets the person there Allow once or Deny a Bash command or a file edit from a card in the Crook window, gives Claude tools to open, split, watch, read and close the tabs and panes it opens there (`crook mcp`; none types into a pane or answers a permission request), and teaches Claude what a Crook pane can do. Does nothing in any other terminal.
